column1: # diplosim knob ranges for the HCC1395 PPC (user choice 2026-11-01: sample knobs, no single value).
# Each seed draws every knob independently; scale log = log-uniform (ranges spanning >= 3x), lin = uniform.
# the rest = spans already tried on HCC1395 (10-31 and 11-01 sweeps; t50 tag fraction about 0.86).
# normal_tumour_fraction (script-only, 2026-11-01): tumour DNA in the matched normal; normal alt per depth
# rises from 0.003 to 0.021 with tumour VAF in t00_n25 (lab_report/2026-11-01_clairs_detection_curve).
# normal_base_error (script-only, 2026-11-01): base error of the matched normal only. Real normal alt per
# depth at low-VAF SNVs is 0.003 including the c share, so the normal's own error is about 0.0005 (0-0.001).
